title: Alcohol Dehydrogenase 1B (ADH1B) Inhibits Proliferation and Metastasis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma via Downregulating FoxM1 Pathway.
snippet: Alcohol dehydrogenase 1B (ADH1B) plays a crucial role in ethanol metabolism, and its polymorphisms are associated with various cancers. title: A prognostic model based on platelet-related genes accurately predicts survival in patients with gastric cancer.
snippet: Platelets contribute to gastric cancer (GC) progression and metastasis. In this study, we aimed to construct a prognostic model based on platelet-related genes (PRGs) to predict outcomes in GC.
